---
title: Helicopter Ground School
description: Free, open ground school for helicopter pilots and the instructors teaching them. Written by a working helicopter instructor.
template: splash
hero:
  tagline: ''
head:
  # Starlight defaults every page to `og:type: article`. The landing page is not
  # an article.
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      property: og:type
      content: website
  # Starlight declares `summary_large_image`, which renders as a degraded or
  # blank card unless an image is actually supplied. Generated by
  # `npm run og:image` — see scripts/make-og-image.mjs.
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      property: og:image
      content: https://collectiveknowledge.pages.dev/og-image.png
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      name: twitter:image
      content: https://collectiveknowledge.pages.dev/og-image.png
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      property: og:image:width
      content: '1200'
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      property: og:image:height
      content: '630'
  - tag: meta
    attrs:
      property: og:image:alt
      content: Collective Knowledge — free, open ground school for helicopter pilots.
---

{/* Everything visible here comes from the Hero override. The home page is the
    hero and nothing else — a headline, one sentence, and the two ways in.

    There is deliberately no fine print *in the hero*: leading with "study
    material only — not an FAA-approved course" hedged the work rather than
    described it. The two quiet links Hero.astro renders below the hero are a
    different thing — navigation, not a hedge — and they exist because this is
    the one page with no sidebar to put them in. */}
